-- Pure combo logic. No Roblox globals are used at load time.
local Combo = {}

local DEFAULTS = {
	grace = 0.35,
	fade = 0.08,
	early = 0.10,
	range = 6,
	minFacingDot = 0.25,
	lateSlack = 0.15,
}

local function merge(options)
	local o = {}
	for k, v in pairs(DEFAULTS) do
		o[k] = v
	end
	if options then
		for k, v in pairs(options) do
			o[k] = v
		end
	end
	return o
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- client

function Combo.client(segments, options)
	return {
		segments = segments,
		options = merge(options),
		index = 0,
		active = false,
		position = 0,
		holdAt = nil,
		holdUntil = 0,
		buffered = false,
		hits = {},
		fadeUntil = 0,
		lastTick = nil,
		seek = false,
		held = false,
		stopFade = nil,
		nonce = 1,
	}
end

local function startSegment(c, i, now, seek)
	c.index = i
	c.active = true
	c.position = c.segments[i].start
	c.holdAt = nil
	c.buffered = false
	c.lastTick = now
	if seek then
		c.seek = true
	end
	c.stopFade = nil
end

local function resetClient(c, now, immediate)
	local wasRunning = c.index > 0
	c.index = 0
	c.active = false
	c.position = 0
	c.holdAt = nil
	c.holdUntil = 0
	c.buffered = false
	c.seek = false
	c.held = false
	if immediate then
		c.fadeUntil = 0
		c.hits = {}
		c.stopFade = 0
	else
		c.fadeUntil = now + c.options.fade
		if wasRunning then
			c.stopFade = c.options.fade
		end
	end
end

Combo.resetClient = resetClient

-- Returns the index of a segment that started (a request should be sent), or nil.
function Combo.click(c, now)
	local n = #c.segments
	if c.active then
		if not c.buffered and c.index < n then
			c.buffered = true
		end
		return nil
	end
	if c.index > 0 then
		if now <= c.holdUntil and c.index < n then
			startSegment(c, c.index + 1, now, true)
			return c.index
		end
		resetClient(c, now, false)
	end
	c.hits = {}
	startSegment(c, 1, now, true)
	return 1
end

-- Advances local time. Position is clamped at the segment end before crossed hits are
-- tested. Returns the index of a buffered segment that started, or nil.
function Combo.tick(c, now)
	local last = c.lastTick or now
	c.lastTick = now
	local n = #c.segments
	if c.active then
		local dt = math.max(0, now - last)
		local seg = c.segments[c.index]
		local prev = c.position
		local nextPos = prev + dt
		if nextPos > seg.finish then
			nextPos = seg.finish
		end
		if seg.hit > prev and seg.hit <= nextPos then
			table.insert(c.hits, c.index)
		end
		c.position = nextPos
		if nextPos >= seg.finish then
			if c.index >= n then
				resetClient(c, now, false)
			elseif c.buffered then
				startSegment(c, c.index + 1, now, false)
				return c.index
			else
				c.active = false
				c.holdAt = seg.finish
				c.holdUntil = now + c.options.grace
			end
		end
	elseif c.index > 0 and now >= c.holdUntil then
		resetClient(c, now, false)
	end
	return nil
end

-- Drives an AnimationTrack (or compatible fake) from client state.
function Combo.playback(c, track)
	if c.active then
		if c.seek then
			c.seek = false
			c.held = false
			if not track.IsPlaying then
				track:Play(0, 1, 1)
			end
			track.TimePosition = c.position
			track:AdjustSpeed(1)
		end
	elseif c.index > 0 and c.holdAt then
		if not c.held then
			c.held = true
			track.TimePosition = c.holdAt
			track:AdjustSpeed(0)
		end
	elseif c.stopFade ~= nil then
		local f = c.stopFade
		c.stopFade = nil
		c.held = false
		if track.IsPlaying then
			track:Stop(f)
		end
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- server

function Combo.server(segments, options)
	return {
		segments = segments,
		options = merge(options),
		nonce = 1,
		alive = true,
		index = 0,
		endAt = 0,
		pending = nil,
		pendingBySegment = {},
		counter = 0,
		hitTargets = {},
	}
end

local function rotate(s)
	s.nonce = s.nonce + 1
	s.index = 0
	s.endAt = 0
	s.pending = nil
	s.pendingBySegment = {}
	s.hitTargets = {}
end

local function refreshPending(s)
	local best
	for i, p in pairs(s.pendingBySegment) do
		if not best or i > best then
			best = i
		end
	end
	s.pending = best and s.pendingBySegment[best] or nil
end

-- Expires the combo window. Returns true when the nonce was rotated.
function Combo.finish(s, now)
	if s.index == 0 then
		return false
	end
	if s.index >= #s.segments then
		if now >= s.endAt then
			rotate(s)
			return true
		end
		return false
	end
	if now > s.endAt + s.options.grace + s.options.lateSlack then
		rotate(s)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

-- Returns ok, reason, hitAt.
function Combo.accept(s, nonce, index, now)
	if not s.alive then
		return false, "dead"
	end
	if nonce ~= s.nonce then
		return false, "stale"
	end
	if type(index) ~= "number" or index % 1 ~= 0 or index < 1 or index > #s.segments then
		return false, "index"
	end
	Combo.finish(s, now)
	if nonce ~= s.nonce then
		-- window expired; the request belonged to the previous combo
		return false, "stale"
	end
	if index ~= s.index + 1 then
		return false, "order"
	end
	local start = now
	if index > 1 then
		if now < s.endAt - s.options.early then
			return false, "early"
		end
		start = math.max(now, s.endAt)
	end
	local seg = s.segments[index]
	local hitAt = start + (seg.hit - seg.start)
	s.index = index
	s.endAt = start + (seg.finish - seg.start)
	s.pendingBySegment[index] = {index = index, hitAt = hitAt, nonce = s.nonce}
	refreshPending(s)
	return true, nil, hitAt
end

-- Sorted indices whose scheduled time has been reached.
function Combo.due(s, now)
	local list = {}
	for i, p in pairs(s.pendingBySegment) do
		if p.hitAt <= now then
			table.insert(list, i)
		end
	end
	table.sort(list)
	return list
end

local function targetValid(s, t)
	if type(t) ~= "table" then return false end
	if not t.alive or not t.inScope or not t.lineOfSight then return false end
	if type(t.distance) ~= "number" or t.distance > s.options.range then return false end
	if type(t.facing) ~= "number" or t.facing < s.options.minFacingDot then return false end
	return true
end

-- Resolves due pending hits (all, or only `index`). The target must be computed by
-- the server. Returns the number of counted hits.
function Combo.hit(s, nonce, now, target, index)
	if nonce ~= s.nonce or not s.alive then
		return 0
	end
	local indices
	if index then
		indices = {index}
	else
		indices = Combo.due(s, now)
	end
	local count = 0
	for _, i in ipairs(indices) do
		local p = s.pendingBySegment[i]
		if p and p.hitAt <= now then
			s.pendingBySegment[i] = nil
			if targetValid(s, target) then
				local key = i .. ":" .. tostring(target.id)
				if not s.hitTargets[key] then
					s.hitTargets[key] = true
					s.counter = s.counter + 1
					count = count + 1
				end
			end
		end
	end
	refreshPending(s)
	return count
end

function Combo.cancel(s)
	rotate(s)
end

function Combo.respawn(s)
	s.alive = true
	rotate(s)
end

function Combo.death(c, s, now)
	if c then
		resetClient(c, now or 0, true)
	end
	if s then
		s.alive = false
		rotate(s)
	end
end

return Combo

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local SCOPE = "Forge_c48fc9be33ea"
local shared = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(SCOPE)
if not shared then
	shared = Instance.new("Folder")
	shared.Name = SCOPE
	shared.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

local Combo = require(shared:WaitForChild("Combo"))
local Config = require(shared:WaitForChild("ComboConfig"))

local remote = shared:FindFirstChild("ComboRemote")
if not remote then
	remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	remote.Name = "ComboRemote"
	remote.Parent = shared
end

local states = {}

local function getScopeFolder()
	return workspace:FindFirstChild(SCOPE)
end

local function getTarget()
	local folder = getScopeFolder()
	return folder and folder:FindFirstChild("StrawTarget") or nil
end

local function publish(player, state)
	player:SetAttribute("ComboNonce", state.server.nonce)
	player:SetAttribute("Hits", state.server.counter)
end

local function getRoot(player)
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return nil, nil end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoid or not root or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return nil, nil end
	return root, character
end

local function nearestPoint(part, p)
	local localPos = part.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(p)
	local h = part.Size / 2
	local c = Vector3.new(
		math.clamp(localPos.X, -h.X, h.X),
		math.clamp(localPos.Y, -h.Y, h.Y),
		math.clamp(localPos.Z, -h.Z, h.Z)
	)
	return part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(c)
end

-- Every field is computed here on the server; nothing comes from the client.
local function computeTarget(player)
	local root, character = getRoot(player)
	local target = getTarget()
	local record = {id = "StrawTarget", alive = false, inScope = false, distance = math.huge, facing = -1, lineOfSight = false}
	if not root or not target then
		return record
	end
	local folder = getScopeFolder()
	record.alive = target.Parent ~= nil
	record.inScope = folder ~= nil and target:IsDescendantOf(folder)

	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}

	local origin = root.Position
	local best
	for _, part in ipairs(target:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			local point = nearestPoint(part, origin)
			local offset = point - origin
			local dist = offset.Magnitude
			local flat = Vector3.new(offset.X, 0, offset.Z)
			local facing = 1
			if flat.Magnitude > 0.001 then
				local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
				look = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
				if look.Magnitude > 0.001 then
					facing = look.Unit:Dot(flat.Unit)
				end
			end
			local los = false
			if dist <= Config.options.range + 1 then
				local dir = offset
				if dist > 0.001 then
					local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, dir + dir.Unit * 0.1, params)
					los = result == nil or result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(target)
				else
					los = true
				end
			end
			local passes = los and dist <= Config.options.range and facing >= Config.options.minFacingDot
			if not best or (passes and not best.passes) or (passes == best.passes and dist < best.dist) then
				best = {dist = dist, facing = facing, los = los, passes = passes}
			end
		end
	end
	if best then
		record.distance = best.dist
		record.facing = best.facing
		record.lineOfSight = best.los
	end
	return record
end

local function rotateNotify(player, state)
	publish(player, state)
end

local function setupPlayer(player)
	local state = {server = Combo.server(Config.segments, Config.options), connections = {}}
	states[player] = state
	publish(player, state)

	local function onCharacter(character)
		Combo.respawn(state.server)
		publish(player, state)
		local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
		if humanoid then
			humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
				Combo.death(nil, state.server, os.clock())
				publish(player, state)
			end)
		end
	end

	state.connections[1] = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacter)
	state.connections[2] = player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
		Combo.cancel(state.server)
		state.server.alive = false
		publish(player, state)
	end)
	if player.Character then
		task.spawn(onCharacter, player.Character)
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupPlayer)
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	setupPlayer(p)
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	local state = states[player]
	if state then
		for _, c in ipairs(state.connections) do
			c:Disconnect()
		end
		Combo.cancel(state.server)
		states[player] = nil
	end
end)

remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, nonce, index)
	local state = states[player]
	if not state or type(nonce) ~= "number" or type(index) ~= "number" then
		return
	end
	local root = getRoot(player)
	if not root then
		return
	end
	local ok = Combo.accept(state.server, nonce, index, os.clock())
	if not ok then
		-- resync; the client resets when ComboNonce differs or via the re-published value
		publish(player, state)
	end
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	local now = os.clock()
	for player, state in pairs(states) do
		local s = state.server
		for _, i in ipairs(Combo.due(s, now)) do
			local target = computeTarget(player)
			Combo.hit(s, s.nonce, now, target, i)
		end
		Combo.finish(s, now)
		publish(player, state)
	end
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local KeyframeSequenceProvider = game:GetService("KeyframeSequenceProvider")

local SCOPE = "Forge_c48fc9be33ea"
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild(SCOPE)
local Combo = require(shared:WaitForChild("Combo"))
local Config = require(shared:WaitForChild("ComboConfig"))
local remote = shared:WaitForChild("ComboRemote")

local client = Combo.client(Config.segments, Config.options)
local track = nil
local humanoid = nil
local animationId = nil

local function getAnimationId()
	if animationId then return animationId end
	local source = shared:WaitForChild("PunchSequence", 10) or ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("PunchSequence", true)
	if not source then return nil end
	if not source:IsA("KeyframeSequence") then
		source = source:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("KeyframeSequence", true)
	end
	if not source then return nil end
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return KeyframeSequenceProvider:RegisterKeyframeSequence(source)
	end)
	if ok then
		animationId = result -- assigned unchanged
	else
		warn("Punch sequence registration failed: " .. tostring(result))
	end
	return animationId
end

local function onCharacter(character)
	Combo.resetClient(client, os.clock(), true)
	track = nil
	humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
	if not humanoid then return end
	local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator", 5)
	if not animator then
		animator = Instance.new("Animator")
		animator.Parent = humanoid
	end
	local id = getAnimationId()
	if id then
		local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
		animation.Name = "PunchCombo"
		animation.AnimationId = id
		local ok, loaded = pcall(function()
			return animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
		end)
		if ok then
			track = loaded
			track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
			track.Looped = false
		else
			warn("Punch animation load failed: " .. tostring(loaded))
		end
	end
	humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
		Combo.death(client, nil, os.clock())
		if track and track.IsPlaying then
			Combo.playback(client, track)
		end
	end)
end

player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
	Combo.death(client, nil, os.clock())
	if track and track.IsPlaying then
		track:Stop(0)
	end
	track = nil
	humanoid = nil
end)

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacter)
if player.Character then
	task.spawn(onCharacter, player.Character)
end

-- The server publishes the combo nonce as a replicated attribute.
local function syncNonce()
	local n = player:GetAttribute("ComboNonce")
	if type(n) == "number" and n ~= client.nonce then
		client.nonce = n
		Combo.resetClient(client, os.clock(), false)
	end
end
player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("ComboNonce"):Connect(syncNonce)
syncNonce()

local function send(index)
	if index then
		remote:FireServer(client.nonce, index)
	end
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if processed or input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		return
	end
	if not track or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end
	send(Combo.click(client, os.clock()))
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	local started = Combo.tick(client, os.clock())
	send(started)
	if track then
		Combo.playback(client, track)
	end
end)

coverage.detail: Desktop MouseButton1 drives Combo.click on the client; one fresh click authorizes one segment with at most one buffered click; segment 13 resets and needs a fresh click. Not natively tested.

Client registers the retained PunchSequence KeyframeSequence, assigns the returned ID unchanged, loads it on the Animator, and holds/resumes/stops the track per segment using Combo.playback. Playback is unverified.

Server owns nonce, ordering, hit schedule, range 6, facing, line of sight and scope; counter increments once per target per segment and is published as the player attribute Hits. No HUD was added, per restrictions. Not natively tested.
Server computes target validity from the physical parts of Workspace/Forge_c48fc9be33ea/StrawTarget (no Humanoid); the scene node is supplied by the harness.
